Out of all the presenters, two in particular stuck out to me - the Libyan speaker and the Irish speaker. One because his talk was so engaging, the other because he was clearly drunk. The Irish speaker spoke first and I had really high hopes for the rest of the meeting after hearing his great talk. But then the Libyan speaker went second, slurring all his words and nearly falling off the stage. Who was the drunk speaker?
A. The Irish speaker
B. The Libyan speaker
C. Not answerable
